sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Fullness in right temple and upper jaw. Pain
over left eyebrow. Painful facial bones. Dizzy. Pres-
sive pain in temples. Pain and pressure in maxillae.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Weakness and emptiness. Burning in
oesophagus and stomach.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Purring sensation in right foot outer
side from heel to toe. Icy coldness of left calf.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Aragallus Lamberti —
White Loco-weed — Rattleweed; Baryta; Oxytropis.
